entries.description: Identity and enduring self-description belong to Mind.
Human beliefs and worldview belong to Mind.
Human preferences belong to Mind and require freshness-aware review.
Human and organisation strategy belongs to Mind.
Human priorities and commitments belong to Mind.
Approved human commitments belong to Mind.
Durable human decisions belong to Mind unless they are purely operational machine decisions.
Approved organisational meaning and business truth belong to Mind.
Durable personal knowledge belongs to Mind.
Human relationship context belongs to Mind.
Reusable machine-executable or agent workflow knowledge belongs to Brain.
Operational procedures and recovery guidance belong to Brain.
AI/tool operating rules belong to Brain.
Deterministic preventive hooks belong to Brain.
Deterministic prevention and regression tests belong to Brain.
Machine/tool capability truth belongs to Brain.
Non-secret reproducible runtime configuration belongs to Brain.
Provider admission and routing policy belongs to Brain.
Approved operational machine decisions and receipts belong to Brain.
Approved operational learning belongs to Brain.
Conversation messages are evidence only until reviewed and promoted.
Tool/runtime logs are evidence only.
Observed runtime state is evidence and can expire.
Failure episodes are evidence until transformed into approved prevention knowledge.
Compact hot recall is a rebuildable projection, never canonical human truth.
Computed relation/index state is rebuildable and non-authoritative.
Search indexes are rebuildable derived state.
Embedding/vector indexes are optional rebuildable accelerators.
Graphify or other visual/semantic graph output is a non-authoritative projection.
Task context packs are ephemeral retrieval products.
Session bootstrap envelopes are ephemeral orientation.
Session continuity handoffs are transient unless separately promoted.
